title: HOPV27
about: HOPV27, the 19th International Conference on Hybrid and Organic Photovoltaics organised by nanoGe, takes place 2 to 4 June 2027 in Valencia, Spain. Oral abstracts are due 8 February 2027; poster abstracts are due 10 May 2027.
card_alt: Card for HOPV27, the conference organised by nanoGe in Valencia, Spain, with oral abstracts due 8 Feb 2027. The photo shows the Sagrada Família in Barcelona, Spain, not Valencia.
